name: Responder
description: An LLMNR, NBT-NS and mDNS poisoner that captures Windows authentication hashes on a local network, and a staging ground for NTLM relay attacks.

commands.explanation: Answers LLMNR, NBT-NS and mDNS queries to capture NetNTLM hashes from hosts looking up bad names.
Also starts the rogue WPAD proxy to capture HTTP authentication.
Enables answers for more query types plus verbose output.
Analyze mode: watches and logs poisoning opportunities without actually answering — safe for recon.

commands.command: sudo responder -I <iface> with SMB=Off, HTTP=Off in Responder.conf
commands.explanation: Turn the SMB and HTTP servers off so ntlmrelayx can bind them for relaying.

commands.command: sudo responder -I <iface> -A then run ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt
commands.explanation: Pairs Responder (listening only) with Impacket ntlmrelayx to relay captured auth.
Captured NetNTLMv1/v2 hashes are written here, one file per protocol and host.
